messages:
maria: quick sync from the Kronos POC call — they asked for throughput sizing, reserved GPU options, autoscale recommendations, and fallback behavior. they want 95th latency ~250ms, steady traffic ~120 rps per tenant, short bursts to ~600 rps (30–60s). can we sketch a recommended runway and high-level pricing?

jin: got it. need a traffic profile (avg tokens/response + avg concurrent sessions) but rough rule-of-thumb from our perf bench: ~100–300 rps per A100 depending on model & batch. for planning, assume 1xA100 per 150 rps steady. for 120 rps steady -> 1 reserved gpu; for 600 rps peak -> reserve 2 + burst to 4.

sam: +1. recommend: reserve 2x A100s for safety, autoscale up to 4 for peaks. enable preheat for canary bursts and prefix caching for chat sessions. also plan AZ fallback to keep availability.

jin: example autoscale config I usually share: 
```yaml
reserved:
  gpus: 2
  instance_type: a100
autoscale:
  max_gpus: 4
  scale_policies:
    - metric: p99_latency
      target_ms: 250
      cooldown: 30s
    - metric: queue_length
      threshold: 50
      cooldown: 10s
preheat:
  enabled: true
  duration: 180s
```
use prefix/KV cache for pinned sessions to reduce token compute on warm path.

liam: quick note on model variant: if they accept a quantized fallback (q4_0-like) we can reduce memory and cost but throughput vs quality tradeoff exists. in our tests q4 reduces memory ~2x but throughput drops ~15–25% on some workloads. suggest canary 10% traffic to quantized variant for 48h.

maria: security asks: Kronos needs KMS + VPC peering + SOC2. can we confirm Private deployment option and effort estimate?

liam: private deployment is fine but needs a support ticket and infra lead — estimate 3–4 weeks for VPC peering + KMS onboarding for a POC (shorter if they accept hosted with VPC endpoints).

sam: rough ballpark pricing for initial ask: reserved 2x A100 (commit) ~ $13k/mo (discounted). burst capacity (two on-demand A100s kept warm) ~ $6k/mo. autoscale minutes + preheat add variable cost — estimate an extra $1.5k–3k/mo depending on burst frequency. will provide formal quote.

maria: customer question: what happens if capacity maxes out during large bursts? recommended fallback policy?

jin: recommend layered fallback: 1) transparently fall back to quantized variant (same model family) 2) if latency critical, fall back to a smaller architecture with cached responses as possible 3) region fallback to secondary region with reduced capacity. all routed by smart routing policy so app still receives responses (maybe slightly degraded).

sam: operationally, we should add circuit-breaker + queue limit to avoid cascading latency spikes. sample canary policy: route 10% traffic to quantized for 24–48h, then ramp. set qos for high-priority tenants.

maria: deploy-bot: any infra events?
deploy-bot: deploy/infra: autoscaler policy v3 applied to kronos-poc env — success (1758123502).

maria: ok next steps: jin, send a one-pager sizing calc + the YAML snippet to Kronos; sam, produce a preliminary pricing slide; liam, estimate private deploy timeline & gating items. I'll coordinate a follow-up call and include their security contact. tagging team: @jin @sam @liam. :thumbsup:
